stations.title: Ambrose
stations.say: Who let a minus charge on a bill?

stations.title: The bill
stations.text: Takes any charge, a minus one too.

stations.title: The counter
stations.text: Each problem answered where it belongs.

captions: Ambrose finds a charge of minus 250 cents on last month's bill, and nothing stopped it.
The bill takes any charge, and every other problem ends up looking just the same.
You throw each problem where it is found and catch it only where it can be handled.
Now the minus charge is refused, with a reason the counter can read out.
Problems travel to whoever can deal with them. Next, cleaning up after them.
